argv: Pins draw over the walker's puck
fix nav-heading audit 7: a look change is [owner] (decision 0252)
ops.body: - [owner] **Pins draw over the walker's puck** (fix nav-heading's ux review U1, Nov 21): a capture pin or a "?" just ahead of the walker covers the heading cone, so walking toward a place hides which way you face. Pre-existing at any bearing; drawing the puck above the pins changes the look, so it waits on a mock-up and the owner (decision 0252), and on what a tap on a pin under the puck should meet (low)
